content: Free SEO Audit Tool – Instant Website & Keyword Density Checker ◎ SEO Audit Tool Scan a page. Read the report. Fix what matters. Free · Runs in your browser · Nothing uploaded The SEO Audit Tool that checks your on-page basics and your keyword density — in one scan. Paste your page's source code below and this seo audit tool will grade your title tag, meta description, headings, image alt text, links, and google keyword density in seconds. Everything runs locally on this page — nothing is sent to a server. 01 Enter your page details Website URL (shown in your report only) Focus keyword (for keyword density calculation) Page HTML source (required) Open your page → right-click → View Page Source → copy everything → paste it here. This is what a real crawler sees, so it's the most accurate way to run a keyword density tool text scan. Try auto-fetch from URL instead Run SEO Audit 0 / 100 Audit report On-page checks Keyword density report A reliable keyword density tool doesn't just count your main term — it checks how naturally it appears against total word count. Most seo audit tool guidance treats 0.5%–2.5% as a healthy keyword density calculation range; anything higher can start to look like keyword stuffing. Keyword Count Density Status Keyword density, explained Search consoles are full of people typing google keyword density , keyword density google , and keyword density for google — but Google has never published an official target number. What this seo audit tool (and most SEO practitioners) actually recommend is using density as a sanity check, not a rule to hit exactly. What is the keyword density formula? The standard keyword density formula is: (number of times the keyword appears ÷ total word count) × 100. Run it for your primary term and for close variants, since a real keyword counter tool should track more than one phrase at once. What counts as the best keyword density? There's no single best keyword density that works for every page. As a starting range, most seo audit tool checklists suggest keeping any one phrase under roughly 2.5% of total words, then adjusting based on how natural the copy reads out loud. Is there a maximum keyword density I should stay under? Once a single phrase repeats far more often than a person would naturally write it, search engines can read that as keyword stuffing. Treat 3%+ as a warning line, and use a word density breakdown across your whole page — not just one term — to catch it early. Can I use this as a keyword density checker text tool without installing anything? Yes — this page works fully in your browser. There's no keyword density tool chrome extension or keyword density chrome extension to install; paste your source and the density tool runs instantly, client-side. Helpful, independent SEO resources This seo audit tool is built for quick checks, not as a replacement for the primary documentation.     {"@type":"Question","name":"What is a brute force attack?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A brute force attack systematically tries every possible character combination until it finds the correct password."}},
    {"@type":"Question","name":"What is credential stuffing?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Credential stuffing is when attackers take usernames and passwords leaked from one breached site and try them on other sites, hoping people reused the same password."}},
    {"@type":"Question","name":"Do I need a password manager if I use a password generator?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. A password manager stores and autofills the unique random passwords a generator creates, so you do not need to memorize them."}},
